channel.title: HOPM emerging open-proxy ports
channel.description: Alerts when a protocol:port newly climbs into the scannable (t-->) open-proxy top ranks, so HOPM operators can extend coverage. Built from the semi-static proxy scan history.

item.description: HTTP on port 1221 has climbed into the scannable open-proxy top ranks: ~1.77% of confirmed t--> (entry==exit) proxies over the last 30 days, ranked #10, up from ~0.0% in the prior 90 days. HOPM operators may want to ensure HTTP:1221 is covered by their scanner config.
